# documentation-actions

> Reusable GitHub Actions and workflows for Docusaurus docs sites and awesome-list repositories.
> Optimized for AI coding agents.

## Quick decision tree (agents)

| Goal | Copy from | Notes |
|------|-----------|-------|
| Full docs CI (lint + links + build) | examples/docs-ci.yml | Prefer umbrella reusable-docs-ci |
| PR build only | examples/test-deploy.yml | |
| Pages deploy | examples/deploy-pages.yml | Modern Pages |
| Link check (soft) | examples/link-check.yml | |
| Awesome list validators | examples/awesome-list-checks.yml | |
| Changelog / docs-index / catalog | matching examples/*.yml | secrets: inherit + contents: write |
| Auto-rebase | examples/auto-rebase-prs.yml | |
| Star thank-you | examples/star-request.yml | pull_request_target |
| Label conflicts | examples/label-conflicted-prs.yml | |
| PR status report | examples/pr-status-report.yml | |
| README ↔ docs sync | examples/readme-docs-sync-check.yml | |
| README-only comment | examples/comment-readme-only.yml | |

## Core rules for agents

1. **Copy, don't invent.** Start from an example under examples/.
2. **Pin third-party Actions** to full SHA with `# vX.Y.Z` comment.
3. **Keep triggers + permissions on the caller.** Reusable workflows contain only the job body.
4. **Append-only index.** Never reorder docs/actions-index.md.
5. **Changelog fragments only.** Never hand-edit CHANGELOG.md.
6. **Line length ≤ 140** in YAML (see .yamllint.yml).
7. **Do not merge** unless the human owner asks.

## Key files

- AGENTS.md — primary agent playbook
- docs/ai-agent-guide.md — adoption and extension flow
- docs/yaml-ai-rules.md — strict YAML rules for agents
- docs/naming.md — current names + v2 rename proposals
- docs/actions-index.md — append-only inventory
- examples/ — thin callers (source of truth)
- skills/ — focused checklists

Pin: LLazyEmail/documentation-actions@v1 (or full SHA + Renovate).
